newsitem.title: FRANCE: French beet sowings 50 pct complete - planters.
newsitem.headline: French beet sowings 50 pct complete - planters.

text.p: Dry weather helped speed up the pace of French sugar beet sowings this week, with farmers hoping to wrap drilling operations during the first week of April, planters said on Friday.
"Weather conditions were excellent and sowings may be over by the middle of next week," an analyst for the French sugar beet planters federation (CGB) told Reuters.
As of March 28, an average 50 pct of area had been sown, roughly the same level as at the same stage last year. Drilling operations were 10 days ahead of the average for the last ten years, he said.

Sowings were now completed in Burgundy and in the south of Paris. In the north, area sown to sugar beets stood at around 15 percent in the Nord-Pas-de Calais region, 75 percent in the Oise region and 35 percent in the Somme and in the Aisne regions.
Planted area was 15 percent in the Ardennes region and 60 percent in Normandy.
Last year sowings were completed around mid-April as rain and cold slowed down farmers' progress in late March.
France produced 4.23 million tonnes of beet sugar in 1996/97.
